title: Introduction
text:
What factors are associated with differences in the financial performance of publicly traded companies?



Financial performance and risk are influenced by a combination of company-specific, industry, market, and macroeconomic characteristics. This project uses machine learning and data science methods to investigate relationships among these factors.



This project will:

Collect financial, economic, market, and other relevant data.
Clean and prepare the data for analysis.
Explore patterns and relationships using data visualization.
Apply multiple machine learning methods.
Compare the results across methods.
Identify important factors associated with financial performance and risk.




To be completed after data collection.



The project will apply:

Clustering
Association Rule Mining (ARM)
Naive Bayes
Decision Trees
Support Vector Machines (SVMs)
Regression
Neural Networks
